consumer: The find-item quest's possession gate (an engine dialogue/mission eligibility check) asking 'does the character have a flashlight at the scope the quest requires?'
scope: The quest possession predicate's own reach (e.g. has_amount/charges_of/has_item_with over the character's possessions including nested container contents), not just top-level wielded/worn/inventory slots
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items — flattens u.wielded_items(), u.worn, and u.inv_const_slice() into a JSON array, re-deriving possession from a partial enumeration instead of invoking the engine's possession predicate
divergence: A flashlight nested inside a worn container/bag (or otherwise reachable to the quest predicate but not surfaced by the flat top-level inv_const_slice walk): the engine's possession check returns true, but the re-derived scan of carried_items reports no flashlight, failing the gate falsely
